(()=>{const i=ellashop.prints.item, a=window.__a, b=window.__b; if(!(i.cx>a.cx)) throw Error('ArrowLeft moves the photo left (crop centre right): '+JSON.stringify({z:i.zoom,cx:i.cx,t:i.tilt})); return 'ArrowLeft moves the photo left (crop centre right) ok'})()
